entries.text: Only the owner of this Mineshaft can interact with this crystal!
entries.zh: 只有此矿井的发现者才能与这颗水晶互动！

entries.text: The Accessory Bag Widget is now ENABLED when in the Mineshaft.
entries.raw: §aThe Accessory Bag Widget is now ENABLED when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 已开启矿井中的饰品袋小部件。

entries.text: The Crystals Widget is now DISABLED when in the Mineshaft.
entries.raw: §cThe Crystals Widget is now DISABLED when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 已关闭矿井中的水晶小部件。
